wilderness.label: Designated Wilderness (BLM)
wilderness.what_it_is: Congress has designated this area as wilderness and BLM administers it as part of the National Wilderness Preservation System.
wilderness.hunting_line: Hunting here is governed by California regulations as on other BLM land. Wilderness rules restrict how you travel and what equipment you may use (43 CFR 6300), not whether you may hunt.

wilderness_study_area.label: Wilderness Study Area (BLM)
wilderness_study_area.what_it_is: BLM has inventoried this area for wilderness characteristics and manages it to preserve them while Congress decides. It is not designated wilderness.
wilderness_study_area.hunting_line: Hunting here is governed by California regulations as on other BLM land. Wilderness study area management restricts how you travel and what equipment you may use (43 CFR 6300), not whether you may hunt.

wsa_recommendation_note: "Recommendation" is BLM's advice to Congress about whether the area should become designated wilderness. It is not a statement about access or hunting, and it does not change how the area is managed until Congress acts.
boundary_caveats: These are jurisdiction boundaries, not a survey and not a property line. BLM publishes them, in its own words, as "generalized polygons".
The lines are simplified to roughly 10 metres for display. Near an edge, treat this as a guide and not as your position relative to the real boundary.
Private inholdings exist inside these boundaries. Where BLM's data carries one it is drawn as a hole; one BLM does not carry is not shown at all.
Temporary closures, fire restrictions and emergency orders are invisible here. This layer shows a designation, not today's conditions.
